subject: Television & Streaming
title: Streaming Breaks Language Barriers
description: A 60-second lesson on Streaming Breaks Language Barriers.

hook.text: Before streaming, foreign-language shows rarely reached American audiences.

buildup.text: Netflix invested billions in local-language content worldwide.

discovery.text: Money Heist from Spain, Dark from Germany, and Squid Game from Korea all became global phenomena.

twist.text: Streaming Breaks Language Barriers has a twist: the obvious interpretation usually breaks down.

climax.text: Streaming created the first truly global television audience. Stories from anywhere can now reach audiences everywhere.

punchline.text: Subtitles went from a barrier to a bridge.

quiz.question: How did streaming platforms change the reach of non-English content?
options: They invested in local-language content, enabling shows from any country to reach global audiences
